Method of Attack: UEFI rootkit malware planted in firmware images to persist through OS reinstallations and storage drive replacements; Modified CSMCORE DXE driver intercepting boot sequence to introduce malicious logic; Deploying kernel-level implant into Windows system at every boot; Setting up hooks to modify OS loader and take control of execution flow to launch shellcode fetching payload from command and control server
Impacted Systems: Firmware images of ASUS and Gigabyte motherboards using H81 chipset; Windows operating systems on infected machines
Attack Vector: Injection into UEFI firmware images, possibly via physical access or precursor malware capable of patching firmware; Legacy boot process modification via compromised CSMCORE DXE driver
